item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Mindset. Your day's got structure — reflection prompts, a check-in on old patterns, moments to question if you're projecting or mind-reading. That's good work, but noticing a thought isn't the same as acting on it. Pick one moment today where you catch a negative pattern, and actually choose a different response instead of just observing it. Action beats awareness.
